sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks C48 row 47; Internal Quality Checks C48 annotation 'Pinned model, temperature 0, versioned prompt, pinned browser, and no unpinned network in the scoring path', superseded for temperature/prompt-version/network by the current public row text)
evidence: Shared pinned judge: task.toml [verifier.env] sets REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code" and REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx" once for every dimension; all five judge.toml files carry only the fallback judge="claude-code" and no model/temperature/reasoning_effort/weight keys (staged-task-contract.md line 140 satisfied); test.sh exits zero-reward if either env var is missing. Pinned CLIs and browser: tests/Dockerfile installs @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, and Chromium via the Playwright CLI bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp (so the browser revision is fixed by that pin), symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium which every judge.toml MCP server uses with --headless --isolated --executable-path. Shared files are byte-identical to the frozen template: tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8...5fdd for both, and diff -rq shows test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py and scoring.toml unchanged; judge.toml diffs vs template are only explanatory comments plus the functional mode=individual/timeout=550 change (a workload matter for other rows, not pinning). Fixed clock: integration.md line 7 publishes 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, seed_data.json clock is the same, app_context.md line 29 tells the judge so, and every graded time figure re-derives from that clock rather than the run date (Boundary note 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z exactly 7 days on 7-day M-11; Rent review +1 s; Costs estimate 2026-05-03T10:00 = nine days; Probate 2026-05-04T09:00 = eight days; Survey booked 2026-05-08 15:00; original lease scan 1 May). The golden server.js measures expiry as CLOCK_MS - Date.parse(at) and stamps new messages/versions/transcripts with CLOCK. Counterexample attempts: (a) a broken app that uses the real Date.now (run date October 2026) would expire every M-11 message on the 7-day timer, failing the positive controls in deleted_and_expired_messages Part B and timer_changes, so it cannot pass by the clock; (b) a conforming app that honours the published clock passes regardless of when the verifier runs, since no criterion compares against the judge host's date. Not a defect per the row's current text: open public verifier network, absent temperature/prompt-version markers. Residual template-controlled items (base images node:22-bookworm-slim/python:3.12-slim by tag not digest, unpinned apt font packages, and inherent LLM judge stochasticity) are identical to the template and outside task authority. This row is source-verifiable; no verifier image build or configured judge run was performed in this review, and none is claimed.
